task.title: Add a test for the /up health check route
task.description: config/routes.rb exposes GET /up (rails/health#show) for load balancers and uptime monitors, but no test in test/ covers it. Add a routing test and an integration test, so that a change to the routes or to authentication filters cannot break the health check without a failing test.
acceptance: A new routing assertion (for example in test/integration/routing/) checks that GET /up routes to rails/health#show.
A new integration test checks that an anonymous GET /up returns 200, also when the setting 'login_required' is enabled.
Only files under test/ change, `bin/harness check-fast` and `bin/harness check` pass, and a dated entry is added to docs/harness/log.md.

acceptance.criterion: A new routing assertion checks that GET /up routes to rails/health#show.
acceptance.evidence: test/integration/routing/health_test.rb RoutingHealthTest#test_health_check passes (`bin/rails test test/integration/routing/health_test.rb test/integration/health_test.rb`: 3 runs, 5 assertions, 0 failures).

acceptance.criterion: A new integration test checks that an anonymous GET /up returns 200, also when 'login_required' is enabled.
Only files under test/ change, bin/harness check-fast and bin/harness check pass, and a dated entry is added to docs/harness/log.md.
acceptance.evidence: Only test/ files changed (git status shows two untracked files under test/). bin/harness and docs/harness/log.md do not exist in this worktree, so I could not run those commands or add the log entry. Equivalent checks run by hand: `bundle exec rubocop --parallel`: 1101 files, no offenses. `PARALLEL_WORKERS=8 bin/rails test`: 6067 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips (SCM repos and LDAP not set up). I did not run Stylelint because no CSS changed.

human_needed.question: This worktree (control-tree, HEAD 60e3910f0) has no bin/harness, docs/harness/log.md or .claude/skills. Should the harness files be added to this tree, or should I create docs/harness/log.md here even though the task says only files under test/ should change?
human_needed.why: The third acceptance criterion depends on files that are missing here. Creating a new docs/ tree is a decision about the repository layout. I should not make that decision alone, and it would also break the 'only test/ changes' rule.

gaps.problem: The implement-change skill and the task refer to bin/harness setup/check-fast/check, but this worktree has no bin/harness. It exists only in the separate ../../repo checkout.
The log file the task asks me to update does not exist in this worktree. There is no docs/ directory, only the upstream doc/ directory.

It does not say which Ruby to use. The Ruby on PATH is the macOS system Ruby 2.6, but the Gemfile needs >= 3.3 and < 4.1. I had to find /opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin by hand. The repo has no .ruby-version or .tool-versions file.
It is missing in a fresh worktree, and nothing in this tree explains how to create it for tests. I wrote a SQLite3 config by copying what ../../repo/bin/harness does.
No document lists the test base classes (Redmine::RoutingTest#should_route, Redmine::IntegrationTest) or the with_settings helper. I found them by reading test_helper.rb and existing tests.

summary: I added a routing test (GET /up -> rails/health#show) and an integration test (anonymous GET /up returns 200 with login_required '0' and '1'). Both pass, whole-repo RuboCop is clean, and the full non-system suite passes (6067 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips). This worktree has no bin/harness, no docs/ directory and no .claude/ skills: they only exist in a separate checkout (../../repo), which I read but did not change. So I could not run `bin/harness check-fast` or `bin/harness check` by name, and I did not add the docs/harness/log.md entry, because creating a new docs/ tree would go against 'only files under test/ change'. Instead I ran the same steps by hand with the Homebrew Ruby, the way bin/harness does.
